outcome.completed: Done: you went through every word and read the whole sentence.

default.title: Could not open the tutor session
default.body: It may be your microphone, speaker or connection. Nothing was deducted.

QUOTA_EXCEEDED.title: No tutor sessions left today
QUOTA_EXCEEDED.body: You have used all of today's tutor sessions. The limit resets at 00:00; Pro is unlimited.

TUTOR_TOO_MANY_FAILED_STARTS.title: Too many failed tutor starts today
TUTOR_TOO_MANY_FAILED_STARTS.body: You have opened the tutor unsuccessfully too many times today. Please try again tomorrow.

AI_CONSENT_REQUIRED.title: AI processing consent needed
AI_CONSENT_REQUIRED.body: Allow AI processing in settings to use the tutor.

TUTOR_LIVE_UNAVAILABLE.title: The tutor is temporarily unavailable
TUTOR_LIVE_UNAVAILABLE.body: See the tips below. Nothing was deducted.

MIC_UNAVAILABLE.title: Microphone or speaker not available
MIC_UNAVAILABLE.body: Allow the microphone for this page and try again.

START_TIMEOUT.title: The tutor did not answer in time
START_TIMEOUT.body: Nothing was deducted. Try again in a few seconds.

CONNECT_ERROR.title: Could not connect to the tutor
CONNECT_ERROR.body: Check your network and try again. Nothing was deducted.

CONNECTION_CLOSED.title: The tutor connection closed
CONNECTION_CLOSED.body: Nothing was deducted. You can try again.

lesson.lockedHint: No tutor sessions left today · Unlock with Pro

ai.title: AI feedback
ai.hint: AI reads this attempt's scores and writes a few short lines of feedback.
ai.failed: Could not write feedback right now. You were not charged, try again later.
ai.busy: AI is busy, please try again in a few minutes. You were not charged.
ai.consent: You need to allow AI processing to see feedback.
ai.quotaOut: You have used all AI feedback for today.

shadowingPractice.title: Listen, repeat, spot mistakes
shadowingPractice.quotaTitle: Free plan: {{limit}} shadowing attempts per day

verdict.good: Great pronunciation! On to the next one.
verdict.mid: Pretty good. Try again to reach 80.
verdict.bad: Not there yet. Listen to the model, then read slowly word by word.

word.clickHint: Tap a word to see each sound
word.insertedHint: Extra word: Azure heard “{{word}}”, which is not in the model sentence
word.omittedHint: Azure did not hear this word

detail.heard: Each box is the model sound and its score; the small → line is what Azure reported when it differs. Pick a sound for its tip and video.
detail.badPhoneme: The sound /{{symbol}}/ is off. Listen to the model, then say it slowly.
detail.goodWord: This word is good. Keep the rhythm and stress of the model.
detail.omittedWord: You skipped this word. Listen to the model and read every word.
detail.noPhonemes: Sound-by-sound detail is only available right after reading. Read the sentence again to see it.
detail.slowWord: Listen to this word again and say each sound slowly, then put it back into the sentence.

finished.title: Lesson complete!
finished.body: Average score {{avg}}. Re-read the sentences under 80 to lock them in.

notes.micBody: Your browser is blocking LinguaLoop from using the microphone.
notes.micStep1: Click the lock icon next to the address.
notes.listenFirst: Listen to the model first, record later
notes.quotaTitle: You have used all {{limit}} shadowing attempts today
notes.quotaBody: New attempts open at 00:00. You can still record to listen back and compare, but it will not be scored.
notes.errorBody: This attempt was not counted. Please try again.
notes.errorOffline: Connection lost. This attempt was not counted, try again when you are online.
notes.noSpeech: No speech was detected. Speak louder and try again.
notes.tooShort: The recording is too short. Read the whole sentence.
notes.tooLong: The recording is over 30 seconds. Read one sentence at a time.
notes.consent: You need to allow AI processing of your voice to get scored.

video.failBody: You can still practise: the model sentence will be read by a synthetic voice.
